title: The First Nuclear Bombs
description: The United States became the first and only civilization in the history of the world to detonate nuclear weapons on a human population. The citizens of Hiroshima and Nagasaki witnessed the devastating effects of such weaponry. Robert Oppenheimer recalled a Hindu proverb:
effects_text:
USA can purchase the first tier of the Arms race for half cost if not already purchased.
USA gain 200 PP.
USA rolls the Destabilize die with the USSR as the target
Other NATO members gain 50 PP each.
button: Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.

title: Perestroika and Glasnost
description: Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev initiates policies to “westernize” portions of the Soviet economy. These policies also aimed at establishing more transparency of Soviet government activities. This eased tensions between NATO and the Warsaw Pact significantly and was a sign that peace could be brokered.
effects_text:
DEFCON raises one level.
NATO and Warsaw Pact members gain 100 PP.
Non-Aligned members gain 30% of their current PP.

title: Falklands War
description: Argentina claims dominion over the Falkland Islands nearby in the Atlantic Ocean. The UK, under the leadership of PM Margaret Thatcher, denied Argentina from claiming sovereignty of the British territory. Intense naval and land battles led to more than 900 deaths. The event strengthened US-UK relations and demonstrated Western military dominance. The event was also carefully studied by the USSR.
effects_text:
UK gains 100 PP.
UK rolls the War Outcome die.
US gains 50 PP.
USSR gains 25 PP.
Argentina loses 50% of current PP.
button: All of that over a pile of rocks?

title: Chernobyl Disaster
description: A nuclear power plant in Ukraine (a satellite state of the USSR) has a meltdown and causes widespread fear around the destructive nature of the atom. It showed incompetence on the side of the Soviets as the disaster was entirely avoidable. Mikhail Gorbachev claimed it led to the eventual collapse of the Soviet Union.
effects_text:
USSR loses 200 PP.
Ukraine loses 50% of current PP.
Warsaw Pact members lose 25 PP.

title: Man on the Moon
description: The USA declared a come from behind victory in the Space Race when Apollo 11 landed on the moon. Neil Armstrong became the first man to step on an extra-terrestrial surface. This was considered the final accomplishment of the Space Race. That's one small step for a man...
effects_text:
The USA gains 200 PP.
USSR loses 100 PP.
The US automatically gains one tier in the Space Race.

title: Cuban Missile Crisis
description: For twelve days, the world stood on the edge of a knife as nuclear missiles were placed in Cuba; easily within striking distance of every major American metropolitan area. These missiles were very nearly launched. Often undiscussed, there were US nuclear missiles were placed in Turkey; easily within striking distance of Soviet metropolitan areas. President Kennedy agreed to not invade Cuba, and Khrushchev agreed to not fire missiles into the US.
effects_text:
Lower the DEFCON one level.
No tiers of the Arms Race may be bought during this round.
Non-Aligned Bloc members gain 50 PP.
Cuba gains extra 25 PP.
Turkey gains extra 25 PP.

title: Tsar Bomba
description: The Soviets test the largest nuclear weapon ever detonated in the history of man. It was the equivalent to 44,000 Hiroshima nuclear bombs. It proved to the world that nuclear weapons could be capable of wiping out the entirety of humanity.
effects_text:
USSR gains 200 PP.
Warsaw Pact members gains 50 PP.
USA loses 200 PP.
NATO members loses 25 PP.
USSR gains one tier for free in the Arms Race.
button: I'm sorry, I must've misheard. It was how big?

title: Death of Joseph Stalin
description: The long-ruling dictator of the Soviet Union, Joseph Stalin, died. This created turmoil in the USSR as uncertainty around the political stability of USSR came into question. Nikita Khrushchev became the leader and reversed many of the policies of Stalin.
effects_text:
USSR loses 100 PP.
Warsaw Pact members lose 10 PP.
Shuffle a pack of cards, if an ace is drawn, lower the DEFCON one level. If a King is drawn, raise the DEFCON one level.

title: Suez Crisis
description: With the aid of the USSR, Egypt seized control of the British-controlled Suez Canal. This triggered an invasion of Egypt by Israel, Britain, and France. The USA and USSR urged attacking powers to withdraw. Many consider this event to mark the end of Britain’s reign as the premier empire of the world. Egypt gained and maintained control of the Suez Canal.
effects_text:
Egypt gains 150 PP.
Israel loses 25 PP.
United Kingdom loses 200 PP.
France loses 50 PP.
All other NATO members lose 10 PP.
USSR gains 25 PP.
Warsaw Pact members gain 10 PP.
Egypt rolls the Destabilize die with the UK as its target.

title: Berlin Blockade
description: With both the Soviets and Western Powers trying to seize control of Germany, the country was split in half. The Soviets would not allow NATO powers to transport goods into Eastern Germany. East Germans starved and were without necessities as Cold War lines were clearly drawn.
effects_text:
USSR gains 100 PP.
West Germany loses 25 PP.
East Germany loses 50 PP.
NATO members lose 25 PP.
USSR rolls the Destabilize die with West Germany as its target.
button: The Iron Curtain Falls Over Europe

title: Yom Kippur War
description: The Soviets back a short war supporting Syria and Egypt against the USA backed Israel. Tensions between the USA and USSR mount as many believed this event could cause WWIII. Israel technically wins and the United Nations negotiates peace.
effects_text:
USSR loses 75 PP.
USA loses 75 PP.
Israel gains 75 PP.
Egypt loses 25 PP.
Syria loses 25 PP.
DEFCON lowers 1 level.

title: The Oil Crisis
description: As a response to the Yom Kippur War, OPEC (Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries) denied sales of oil to the USA due to its military aid to Israel.
effects_text:
USA loses 250 PP.
Saudi Arabia gains 100 PP.
Israel loses 10 PP.
Saudi Arabia rolls the Destabilize die with the USA as the target.

title: Soviet Afghan War
description: The Soviets fought alongside the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan against the NATO-backed Mujahedeen. The arduous war was an abject failure for the Soviets known as the 'Bear Trap' in the 'Graveyard of Empires.'
effects_text:
USSR loses 30% of current PP.
Afghanistan gains 200 PP.
US gains100 PP.
US gains free successful espionage.
Warsaw Pact loses one of its member countries to the Non-Aligned (Warsaw Pact votes).
Afghanistan rolls the Destabilize die with the USSR as the target.

title: Sputnik Satellite Launch
description: The USSR launched the first satellite into orbit and successfully received transmissions. This event terrified the populace and leaders of NATO. The Space Race became vastly more important and the USA would throw support and funds into space research.
effects_text:
NATO loses 150 PP.
Warsaw Pact gains 100 PP.
USSR gains the second tier of the Space Race whether or not the first tier is already purchased.

title: SALT I & SALT II Agreements
description: The SALT (Strategic Armaments Limitation Talks) agreements were designed to relieve tensions between nuclear armed USSR and USA. The first SALT did little to fix the issue, but the second SALT did have some effect in limiting and reducing armaments.
effects_text:
Raise the DEFCON one level.
USA loses one tier in the Arms Race
USSR loses one tier in the Arms Race
Non-Aligned, NATO, and Warsaw pact members all gain 50 PP.

title: Nixon in China
description: USA President Richard Nixon visited China to meet with Chairman Mao after decades of zero contact. The summit was successful in opening lines of communication and trade between the countries. China started to incorporate more capitalist elements in the Chinese economy after this visit.
effects_text:
China gains 50% of current PP.
USA gains 200 PP.
DEFCON raises 1 level.

title: Assassination of President Kennedy
description: The USA is collectively in distress after the televised assassination of President Kennedy. Conspiracy theories around the event immediately begin to circulate up as the Cold War world looked for a new path forward with the new President Lyndon Johnson.
effects_text:
USA loses 100 PP.
Flip a coin - heads, DEFCON lowers one level / tails, DEFCON remains at its current level.

title: The Great Leap Forward
description: Chairman Mao of China implements his plan, The Great Leap Forward. The goal was to industrialize agricultural China. It was in fact a disaster as the country experienced mass starvation with a death toll in the tens of millions.

effects.question: Is the Great Leap Forward referenced in Billy Joel's 1989 hit 'We Didn't Start the Fire'?

effects_text:
China cannot make any action this round.
China must answer the following question:
Is the Great Leap Forward referenced in Billy Joel's 1989 megahit 'We Didn't Start the Fire'?
If correct, China only loses 50% of current PP
If incorrect, china loses an extra 75% of current PP

title: Bay of Pigs Invasion
description: The USA financed and supported a Coup d'Etat complete with an invasion force of 1,400 CIA trained anti-Communist Cuban exiles. The USA-backed Cuban exiles were quickly overwhelmed by Fidel Castro's forces. The failure of the Coup d'Etat was a major blow to the perception of American hegemony in the western hemisphere.
effects_text:
USA loses 10% of current PP.
Cuba gains 100 PP.
Cuba rolls the Destabilize die - target USA.

title: Vietnam War
description: France lost colonial control over Vietnam in the First Indochina War. In response, the North Vietnamese, backed by the USSR and China, made major advancements to take over the entire country. The USA and other anti-Communist countries ramped up the South Vietnamese war effort by putting their own boots on the ground. Even with increased manpower and firepower on the side of South Vietnam, the North Vietnamese eventually took the southern Capitol. Surrounding countries of Laos and Cambodia would also fall to Communism after the war. Throughout the war, American public opinion slowly and steadily waned; making Vietnam a massively unpopular war. The loss of Vietnam is arguably the most embarrassing military event of the USA's history.
effects_text:
Vietnam rolls the War Outcome die.
USSR gains 100 PP.
China gains 50 PP
USA loses 300 PP.

title: Korean War
description: The USSR and China trained and funded the Korean Peoples Army (North Korea) in their takeover of Korea peninsula. South Korea would receive support from the United Nations. The USA in particular landed with boots on the ground in attempt to stop the spread of Communism. The war ended in an eventual stalemate at the 38th parallel, coincidentally the same place the war began. The two countries have been in a constant state of preparation of war ever since as a peace treaty was never signed.
effects_text:
North Korea gains 150 PP.
China gains 50 PP
USSR gains 100 PP
USA loses 100 PP
South Korea loses 50% of current PP
North Korea rolls the War Outcome die.

title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
description: After decades of East and West Germany being cut off from one another. Separated by a concrete wall, pressure mounted in West Germany to force the East German government to tear down the Berlin wall. The reunification of Germany was imminent and it appeared that the final days of the Cold War were on the horizon.

effects.question: Is the Fall of the Berlin Wall referenced in Billy Joel's 1989 hit 'We Didn't Start the Fire'?

effects_text:
East Germany gains 100 PP.
West Germany gains 100 PP.
All other NATO members gain 50 PP.
All other Warsaw Pact members gain 50 PP
West Germany must answer this question:
Is the Fall of the Berlin Wall referenced in Billy Joel's 1989 megahit 'We Didn't Start the Fire'?
If correct, the DEFCON raises to level 5 and both East & West Germany gain an extra 50 PP.
If incorrect, the DEFCON raises 1 level.

title: Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty
description: This treaty was signed by the major and non-major nuclear powers of the world. The agreement was designed to downsize the amount of nuclear arms, stop the spread of nuclear arms, and define the right to peacefully use nuclear energy.
effects_text:
Raise the DEFCON two levels.
Non-Aligned Bloc members gain 50 PP.
USSR and USA lose 5% current power points and 1 war power each.

title: Angolan Civil War
description: Angola fought for their independence from Portugal whom colonized Angola. The USSR and Cuba backed the Marxist-Communist MPLA. The USA and South Africa backed the anti-Communist UNITA. The USA and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Zaire) also backed a third anti-Communist actor, the FNLA. As Capitalism and Communism jockeyed for more regional control around the world, this proxy war became an imbroglio. The war continued for decades and the support from major powers were soon directed elsewhere in the world.
effects_text:
USA gain 50 PP.
South Africa gain 25 PP
USSR gain 50 PP
Cuba gain 25 PP
Cuba rolls the War Outcome die
button: Fire in the Heart of Africa

title: Nicaraguan Revolution
description: The USSR-backed Sandinistas were a Marxist Communist revolutionary group that overthrew the USA-backed Somoza dictatorship whom were in control of Nicaragua. The Sandinistas were successful in overthrowing the Somoza family and it became an embarrassment for the USA as Nicaragua is well within the American sphere of influence. For the next decade, the USA would then back the Contra rebels through the CIA. The war finally ended with the conclusion of the Iran-Contra scandal that was uncovered in 1986, bringing international scandal to the Reagan administration and leading to a negotiated end to the conflict.
effects_text:
USSR rolls the Coup d'Etat die.
USSR gains 100 PP.
USA loses 10% of current PP.
Nicaragua rolls the Coup d'Etat die.
Nicaragua gains 75 PP.

title: Detente
description: Led by President Nixon, Detente was a genuinely successful attempt to cool the tensions between the USA and USSR as well as other Communist countries. This was done through open and continued communication, treaties, and agreements between eastern and western countries.

effects.question: Is Detente referenced in Billy Joel's 1989 megahit 'We Didn't Start the Fire'?

effects_text:
Non-aligned countries gain 25 PP.
The USSR must answer this question:
Is Detente referenced in Billy Joel's 1989 megahit 'We Didn't Start the Fire'?
If correct, raise the DEFCON 3 levels.
If incorrect, the DEFCON remains where it currently is.

title: START 1
description: The Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty was an agreement between the USA and the USSR to significantly downsize the amount of nuclear arms between the two powers. While this was a rather successful event, each side continues to maintain between 5,000 and 6,000 warheads; this is significantly reduced from its peak of more than 47,000 held by the USSR in the 1970s.
effects_text:
DEFCON automatically raises to level 5.
USSR and USA gain 300 PP.
Non-Aligned, NATO, and Warsaw Pact members each gain 50 PP.

title: U2 Incident
description: A USA piloted U2 Spy Plane was performing reconnaissance over the USSR. The plane was shot down and it led to a massive breakdown in communication and relations between the east and west.

effects.question: Is the U2 Incident referenced in Billy Joel's 1989 mega hit 'We Didn't Start the Fire'?

effects_text:
USA answers this question:
Is the U2 Incident referenced in Billy Joel's 1989 mega hit 'We Didn't Start the Fire'?
If correct, raise the DEFCON 1 level.
If incorrect, USSR and Warsaw Pact members gain 50 PP and USSR rolls the Classified Documents die

title: Able Archer 83
description: Able Archer was a USA attempt at a simulated military exercise of war between the USSR and NATO in a scenario where DEFCON reached level one. The authenticity of the exercise was covertly observed by the USSR. The USSR and the rest of the Warsaw Pact quickly began scrambling to respond with overwhelming force. A USA general chose not to respond to the military mobilization that was observed in Warsaw Pact countries. This incident was declassified in 2015. In 2021, further declassified documents supported the supposition that it was one of very near “misses” from nuclear annihilation.
effects_text:
DEFCON lowers one level.
USA, flip a coin, if it is heads, DEFCON raises two levels. If it is tails, the DEFCON remains the same.
USA rolls the Destabilize die.
button: Hold on - is the other side mobilizing?

title: Iranian Coup d'Etat
description: The USA and UK employed a coup d'etat against the Mohammad Mosaddegh regime as the Mosaddegh government was attempting to audit British oil companies operating in Iran and there was a strong movement to nationalize the oil industry. The CIA staged paid 'protestors' to drum up an overthrow of the Mosaddegh regime in favor of the Shah (king) Mohammad Reza. Shah Reza was supported and held up by the CIA and Mosaddegh was arrested, and later sentenced to death, though was spared by the Shah with a pardon.
effects_text:
UK roll the Coup d'Etat die.
USA rolls the Coup d'Etat die
Iran loses 10% PP.

title: Bangladesh Liberation War (1971) & 'Smiling Buddha' (1974)
description: The Mukti Bahini was Bangladeshi rebel group with intentions of self-determination (start their own nation) against the Chinese-backed Pakistan. Mukti Bahini was militarily supported and funded by India and the USSR. Pakistan answered by committing genocide against the Bangledeshi people. In the end, Mukti Bahini was successful in establishing their own independent nation of Bangladesh. In response to this loss, Pakistan began a nuclear weapons program as hatred for India had grown vigorously during the war. India, to defend itself against China and Pakistan, had started a nuclear program in 1947. In 1974, India successfully tested their first nuclear weapon, known as "Smiling Buddha". Pakistan responded by stealing nuclear plans from Europe with the help of China and developed their own nuclear weapons leading to high tensions in the Indian sub-continent.
effects_text:
USSR gains 50 PP.
India gains 100 PP.
China loses 25 PP.
Pakistan loses 25% of current PP.
Pakistan rolls the Classified Documents die.
India rolls the War Outcome die.
DEFCON lowers 1 level.

title: Iranian Hostage Crisis
description: 53 American diplomats were taken hostage by Iranian Revolutionaries angered by the USA's orchestration of the Iranian coup d'etat in 1953. President Jimmy Carter struggled to free the hostages resulting in an embarrassing moment for the USA. Incoming president Ronald Reagan quickly negotiated the release of the hostages when inaugurated in the 1981.  Significant evidence released in 2023 and 2024 points to a covert deal being made to hold the hostages until Reagan's election victory and inauguration.
effects_text:
USA lose 100 PP.
Iran roll the Destabilize die with USA as the target.

title: Vostock 1 Mission
description: The USSR became the first country to put a man in space as Yuri Gagarin orbited Earth for about an hour and a half. This moment encouraged the USA to ramp up the space program with President Kennedy claiming that the United States would put a man on the moon before the end of the decade.

effects.question: Spend 600 PP now to jump directly to Space Race Tier 3?

effects_text:
USSR gains 50 PP.
USSR gains the third tier of the Space Race for a one time cost of 600 PP.
USA loses 50 PP.
